narrative: A penny loaf on Mistress Ansell's bread-board, a thumb short of the notch. She has left it there. The notch is the old one, cut in a good year. Morning light. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the loaf she had left out, and did not cut it.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: In photo: A thumb short of the notch
